mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM landmark l LEFT JOIN landmark_category lc ON lc.id = l.landmark_category_id

SELECT l.id, l.name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.recommendation_score_count,0) > 0 THEN (l.recommendation_score_sum / l.recommendation_score_count) ELSE 0 END AS score, (SELECT i.url FROM image i JOIN album a ON i.album_id = a.id WHERE a.landmark_id = l.id AND i.is_show = true LIMIT 1) AS cover_url, l.check_in_count, l.tags, l.open_time, lc.name AS category_name FROM landmark l LEFT JOIN landmark_category lc ON lc.id = l.landmark_category_id
ORDER BY score DESC, l.check_in_count DESC
ORDER BY l.name ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT floor_number, floor_name, tags FROM floor WHERE landmark_id = #{id} ORDER BY floor_number ASC
SELECT i.url FROM image i JOIN album a ON i.album_id = a.id WHERE a.landmark_id = #{id} ORDER BY i.id

SELECT l.id, l.name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.recommendation_score_count,0) > 0 THEN (l.recommendation_score_sum / l.recommendation_score_count) ELSE 0 END AS score, l.check_in_count, l.tags, l.open_time, lc.name AS category_name, l.built_time, l.description, l.location_description, cp.name AS campus_name, u.name AS university_name FROM landmark l LEFT JOIN landmark_category lc ON lc.id = l.landmark_category_id LEFT JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = l.campus_id LEFT JOIN university u ON u.id = cp.university_id WHERE l.id = #{id}
